title: MAX, MIN and LIMIT in a fail-safe LAD block

importRefusal.format: SimaticML, F_LAD FC with one Max, Min or Limit part
importRefusal.message: An instruction with the name 'Max' cannot be found at the object with UID '24'. / An instruction with the name 'Min' cannot be found ... / An instruction with the name 'Limit' cannot be found ...

intendedError: MAX, MIN and LIMIT boxes in F_LAD
notes: Added 2026-10-24 by PLC Studio (verification session 5). TIA refused every import, so there is no TIA export: documents/ holds the SIMATIC SD text of the blocks PLC Studio tried. In F_LAD, SimaticML imports of Max, Min and Limit parts were refused because no instruction of that name exists there; as controls, a standard LAD block with a Max part got past the name check (refused only for its ENO and template settings), and an F_LAD block with a Move part was found too (refused for DisabledENO). Earlier attempts in SIMATIC SD: MAX refused ("Operand '#X2' is not valid for this instruction."), Limit crashed TIA (session 3).
